what: three stages of the residual pipeline: (1) the residual built by two subtractions, (2) the same measurement written two ways, the second of which is the target string, (3) the signed-rank vector that NIR actually ranks. New in v2: stage 3, and the residual glyph in stage 1 drawn as a real signed bar profile instead of v1's three visible dashes.
